services.title: Computer & Laptop Chip-Level Repair
services.shortDescription: Expert hardware diagnosis, motherboard repair, broken screen replacement, liquid damage recovery, and OS re-installation.
services.fullDescription: Our certified technicians provide comprehensive chip-level repairs for all laptop and desktop brands (Dell, HP, Lenovo, Asus, Acer, Apple). We handle power rail short circuits, BIOS reprogramming, thermal re-pasting, hinge rebuilding, NVMe SSD upgrades, and data recovery.
features: Motherboard chip-level diagnostics & micro-soldering
Display replacement (FHD/OLED/IPS panels)
Battery replacement & charging port rebuilding
Clean OS installation, driver tuning & virus removal
Physical liquid damage remediation with ultrasonic cleaning
services.pricingNote: Free initial inspection & quotation. Basic service starting from रु 500.

faqs.question: Where is Krishna Electronics located in Surkhet?
faqs.answer: Our main store and technical repair laboratory is situated at Birendranagar-6, Buddhapath, Surkhet, Nepal. You can visit us during business hours from Sunday to Friday.

faqs.question: Do you deliver electronics and equipment outside Surkhet Valley?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer direct same-day/next-day local delivery across the Surkhet Valley and dispatch verified orders to Dailekh, Jajarkot, Jumla, Kalikot, Salyan, and across Karnali Province via reliable transport networks.

faqs.question: Do you provide on-site CCTV and Wi-Fi installation services?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our experienced networking and surveillance engineers carry out site surveys, structured cabling, camera mounting, router configuration, and mobile app setup directly at your home, office, school, or business facility.

faqs.question: What warranty is offered on electronics and repairs?
faqs.answer: All brand-new laptops, networking hardware, and CCTV systems carry official manufacturer warranties (typically 1 to 2 years). Hardware repairs conducted in our laboratory come with dedicated service warranties.

faqs.question: How do Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) work for offices?
faqs.answer: Under our AMC agreements, we perform monthly scheduled hardware cleanings, network optimization, preventative checkups, and provide priority on-call troubleshooting whenever any computer, printer, or network device faces issues.
